headline: Ratifying appointments of assistant election officials for the November 2026 General Election.
summary: A consent agenda item, sponsored by Councilor Traverse, asks the board to ratify the appointments and waive the reading of the resolution. The rest of the agenda covers adopting the agenda and the consent agenda.
items: Adopt the consent agenda and the actions it lists
Resolution ratifying the appointment of assistant election officials for the November 2026 General Election (Councilor Traverse)
